company.shortDescription: Risklytics uses artificial intelligence to support the placement of hard-to-place and excess and surplus commercial insurance risks.
company.description: Risklytics is a commercial insurance brokerage that uses artificial intelligence to support the placement of hard-to-place and excess and surplus commercial insurance risks. The company helps businesses prepare insurance submissions by collecting and organizing relevant risk information and matching accounts with carriers based on underwriting appetite. Its platform combines AI-driven coordination with human review to streamline communication and reduce administrative work during the insurance placement process. Risklytics provides coverage guidance across a range of industries and supports the submission process by identifying appropriate insurance markets for different types of commercial risks. The company focuses on improving the efficiency of commercial insurance workflows while maintaining human oversight for underwriting and risk assessment decisions.
